actions.action: Inspect specks closely with a magnifier or phone macro to see if they move
Tap a leaf over white paper to check for moving dots
Rinse the plant in the shower with lukewarm water
Check the roots and soil moisture
Repot into fresh chunky aroid mix if soil smells bad or stays wet
If mealybugs or thrips are confirmed, apply a systemic insecticide (imidacloprid or acetamiprid)
Spray insecticidal soap or spinosad every 5-7 days for a few weeks
If mites are confirmed, use a miticide or repeated soap or oil sprays
Isolate the plant from other plants
Take a sharp close-up photo of the specks and post it

reason: The answer lists pests only among several possibilities and leans toward dead casings, residue and chemical burn. It never suggests the alcohol wipe-down that worked, and its advice to stop all spraying for 1-2 weeks would delay treating an active infestation.
